items.html: And the matter is that all this growth is only for himself, that is, to grow his limbs and his body. But after he grew, at nine years and one day, then his brains must be corrected from the Mochin of Aba and Ima themselves, which are drawn from the HGT of Arich; and through this he too will be able to give birth, like his father and mother, who gave birth to him and to the Nukva.
